icons.usage: Use Phosphor Icons (Regular or Bold weight). Calculator: 'MathOperations' or 'GridFour'. History: 'ClockCounterClockwise'. Reference: 'BookOpenText'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts in global CSS (or via index.html): `@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap');`.
Set up Tailwind configuration to include the custom colors (`background`, `surface_main`, etc.) and fonts (`ui`, `math`) defined in these guidelines.
Install the required icon library: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
Structure the main app view as a mobile web app: Use `max-w-md mx-auto` on the root container to simulate a phone screen on desktop, with a fixed bottom navigation bar at `bottom-0`.

For the Calculator Tab: Create a top section for the 'Operation Picker' (e.g., Shadcn Select). Show the required matrix/vector input sections based on the chosen operation (multiply_matrix, apply_gate, normalize_vector, tensor_product, measure).
Implement an 'Input Mode' toggle (Grid vs Text/JSON) for matrices. The Grid mode should dynamically render RxC inputs based on a dimension selector (e.g., 2x2, 4x4).

When displaying output matrices in the result section, wrap the grid in a div with `border-l-2 border-r-2 border-text_secondary rounded-none` to mimic mathematical bracket notation. Do NOT use standard Shadcn cards for mathematical output arrays.
For complex numbers in inputs and results, format them elegantly. For example, `0.707 + 0.707i`, where 'i' has a subtle accent color or italic styling.
In the History tab, store operations locally (using localStorage or state). Display them as cards showing the operation name, timestamp, and a condensed preview of the result.
In the Reference tab, hardcode a list of common quantum gates (Hadamard, Pauli-X, Pauli-Y, Pauli-Z, CNOT) with their symbolic representation and exact matrix definitions.
The Histogram component (for the 'measure' operation) should be built using simple flexbox columns with dynamic heights (e.g., `style={{ height: `${prob}%` }}`) based on probability percentages.
Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (tabs, operation select, input cells, textareas, compute button, history items) to facilitate automated testing.
Ensure the bottom navigation uses appropriate bottom padding (`pb-[84px]`) on the main container so content is not obscured by the tab bar.

accessibility.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have visible focus rings (`focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent_cyan focus:outline-none`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA, specifically checking `#text_muted` against `#surface_main`.
accessibility.screen_readers: Add aria-labels to matrix cell inputs indicating their row and column index (e.g., 'Row 1, Column 1').
